limitations: Single-pass image bootstrap does not establish repeated timing stability.
Same images reused from prior experiments; no project-unseen generalization claim.
Automatic caption metrics and final-answer accuracy do not establish full factual quality.
Same-threshold comparison is not equal-quality or equal-acceptance Pareto calibration.
Feature counters do not isolate synchronized feature latency.
scientific_conclusion: BEPC has lower token/s point estimates than plain Margin in all three tasks and higher request latency point estimates. MAT is nearly unchanged. Small automatic quality gains/tradeoffs do not establish general superiority or three-task quality-preserving acceleration.
